headline: Anthropic stock slips under $83 IPO price
pages: Anthropic's stock fell below its $83 IPO price on Tuesday, trading as low as $76 by midday, down nearly 12% from Monday's close. The slide came less than a week after the company debuted on Nasdaq at $111. 50 a share. Falling below the IPO price is often read as a negative signal, since underwriters usually price offerings at a discount to expected trading value. Investors and venture capitalists have watched the stock as a barometer for how public markets value AI companies. If it keeps trading poorly, private startup valuations could come under pressure and IPO plans for other AI firms could weaken.
Nvidia also fell more than 7% by midday, giving back part of Monday's gain of more than 30% after Jensen Huang was reinstated as CEO. Source: TechCrunch.
